importance_rationale: DECtp 1988 announcement was a contemporaneous landmark that reframed how the industry measured, priced, scaled, and procured transaction processing — first rigorous tps + $/tps spec carried into a public benchmark against IBM.
relevance_rationale: $/tps thinking, standardized benchmarks, RDBMS as the TP substrate, and scale-as-procurement-requirement are still load-bearing in 2026.
prescience_rationale: Six inflection-point bets all won on the timelines implied: focus on $/tps for two decades, RDBMS as TP benchmark standard, scaling counts, standardized TPC benchmarks, DEC TP business doubled in a year, TPC became undisputed arbiter. See kastner-author/notes/dectp_prescience_rationale_2026_06_13.md for full argument of record.
